modules.title: APT 源整理
modules.script:
#!/bin/bash
# x-pxe 初始化模块 apt_sources：APT 源整理
set -euo pipefail

# 经典 sources.list 与 *.list：注释掉 deb cdrom: 行；deb822 指向 cdrom 的 *.sources 改名禁用
shopt -s nullglob
for f in /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.list; do
  [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
  sed -i -E 's/^[[:space:]]*(deb(-src)?[[:space:]]+cdrom:)/# \1/' "$f"
done
for f in /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.sources; do
  if grep -qiE '^URIs:[[:space:]]*cdrom:' "$f"; then
    mv -f "$f" "${f}.disabled-cdrom"
  fi
done
shopt -u nullglob
# 只恢复已有的被注释 http(s) 行，不写入新地址
shopt -s nullglob
for f in /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.list; do
  [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
  sed -i -E 's/^#[[:space:]]*(deb(-src)?[[:space:]]+https?:)/\1/' "$f"
done
shopt -u nullglob
has_net_src=0
if grep -RqhE '^[[:space:]]*deb(-src)?[[:space:]]+https?:' /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d 2>/dev/null; then
  has_net_src=1
fi
shopt -s nullglob
for f in /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.sources; do
  if grep -qiE '^URIs:[[:space:]]*https?:' "$f"; then
    has_net_src=1
    break
  fi
done
shopt -u nullglob
if [[ "$has_net_src" -eq 0 ]]; then
  echo "未检测到网络 APT 源，写入兜底 deb822 源"
  cat > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources << 'XPXE_EOF'
Types: deb
URIs: https://deb.debian.org/debian
Suites: trixie trixie-updates trixie-backports
Components: main contrib non-free non-free-firmware
Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg

Types: deb
URIs: https://deb.debian.org/debian-security
Suites: trixie-security
Components: main contrib non-free non-free-firmware
Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg
XPXE_EOF
fi
apt-get autoclean -y || true
apt-get update

modules.title: 用户与公钥
modules.script:
#!/bin/bash
# x-pxe 初始化模块 users_keys：用户与公钥
set -euo pipefail

if grep -qE '^#? ?SHELL=' /etc/default/useradd; then
  sed -i -E 's|^#? ?SHELL=.*|SHELL=/bin/bash|' /etc/default/useradd
else
  echo 'SHELL=/bin/bash' >> /etc/default/useradd
fi
install -d -m 700 /root/.ssh
touch /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
grep -qxF 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIBtCscA5CqkUDclClV2dKSGH4JxR2vLulpTgLR34Pz1l jay@localhost' /root/.ssh/authorized_keys || echo 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIBtCscA5CqkUDclClV2dKSGH4JxR2vLulpTgLR34Pz1l jay@localhost' >> /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys

# ---- jwczjzl ----
if ! id -u 'jwczjzl' &>/dev/null; then
  useradd -m -s '/bin/bash' 'jwczjzl'
fi
usermod -s '/bin/bash' 'jwczjzl'
passwd -l 'jwczjzl' >/dev/null
usermod -aG 'sudo' 'jwczjzl'
home="$(getent passwd 'jwczjzl' | cut -d: -f6)"
install -d -m 700 "${home}/.ssh"
if [[ ! -f "${home}/.ssh/authorized_keys" ]]; then
  if [[ -f /root/.ssh/authorized_keys ]]; then
    cp /root/.ssh/authorized_keys "${home}/.ssh/authorized_keys"
  else
    touch "${home}/.ssh/authorized_keys"
  fi
fi
grep -qxF 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIBtCscA5CqkUDclClV2dKSGH4JxR2vLulpTgLR34Pz1l jay@localhost' "${home}/.ssh/authorized_keys" || echo 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIBtCscA5CqkUDclClV2dKSGH4JxR2vLulpTgLR34Pz1l jay@localhost' >> "${home}/.ssh/authorized_keys"
chmod 600 "${home}/.ssh/authorized_keys"
chown -R 'jwczjzl': "${home}/.ssh"
loginctl enable-linger 'jwczjzl'

#!/bin/bash
# x-pxe 初始化模块 time_sync：时间同步
set -euo pipefail

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
if ! dpkg-query -W -f='${Status}' systemd-timesyncd 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'install ok installed'; then
  apt-get install -y systemd-timesyncd
fi
mkdir -p /etc/systemd/timesyncd.conf.d
cat > /etc/systemd/timesyncd.conf.d/ntp.conf << 'XPXE_EOF'
[Time]
NTP=ntp.aliyun.com
XPXE_EOF
systemctl enable --now systemd-timesyncd
systemctl restart systemd-timesyncd

modules.script:
#!/bin/bash
# x-pxe 初始化模块 locale：语言环境
set -euo pipefail

cat > /etc/default/locale << 'XPXE_EOF'
LANG="en_US.UTF-8"
LC_ALL="en_US.UTF-8"
LANGUAGE="en_US.UTF-8"
XPXE_EOF
touch /etc/locale.gen
sed -i 's/^# *zh_CN.UTF-8 UTF-8/zh_CN.UTF-8 UTF-8/' /etc/locale.gen
sed -i 's/^# *en_US.UTF-8 UTF-8/en_US.UTF-8 UTF-8/' /etc/locale.gen
grep -qxF 'zh_CN.UTF-8 UTF-8' /etc/locale.gen || echo 'zh_CN.UTF-8 UTF-8' >> /etc/locale.gen
grep -qxF 'en_US.UTF-8 UTF-8' /etc/locale.gen || echo 'en_US.UTF-8 UTF-8' >> /etc/locale.gen
locale-gen
update-locale LANG='en_US.UTF-8' LC_ALL='en_US.UTF-8' LANGUAGE='en_US.UTF-8'

modules.title: SSH 服务配置
modules.script:
#!/bin/bash
# x-pxe 初始化模块 sshd：SSH 服务配置
set -euo pipefail

mkdir -p /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d
cat > /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/jwczjzl.conf << 'XPXE_EOF'
PermitRootLogin no
X11Forwarding no
X11UseLocalhost yes
AllowTcpForwarding yes
AllowAgentForwarding yes
IgnoreRhosts yes
GSSAPIAuthentication no
UseDNS no
Compression no
TCPKeepAlive yes
PasswordAuthentication no
Banner /etc/issue
XPXE_EOF
sed -i 's/^#\?X11Forwarding.*/X11Forwarding no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config 2>/dev/null || true
if ! grep -qiE '^\s*Banner\s+' /etc/ssh/sshd_config; then
  echo 'Banner /etc/issue' >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config
else
  sed -ri 's#^\s*(banner|Banner)\s+.*#Banner /etc/issue#' /etc/ssh/sshd_config
fi
sshd -t
systemctl reload ssh 2>/dev/null || systemctl restart ssh

modules.title: sudoers
modules.script:
#!/bin/bash
# x-pxe 初始化模块 sudoers：sudoers
set -euo pipefail

cp -a /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.ori 2>/dev/null || true
tmp="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "${tmp}"' EXIT
cat > "${tmp}" << 'XPXE_EOF'
# 环境与审计（模块化；不替换整份 /etc/sudoers）
Defaults    env_reset
Defaults    env_keep += "HOME"
Defaults    env_delete = "HTTP_PROXY HTTPS_PROXY"
Defaults    passwd_tries=3
Defaults    timestamp_timeout=10
Defaults    secure_path="/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin"
Defaults    use_pty
Defaults    logfile="/var/log/sudo.log"

# 常用运维命令免密；完整管理仍走 Debian 默认 %sudo ALL=(ALL:ALL) ALL（需密码）
Cmnd_Alias SYSADMIN = /usr/sbin/service, /usr/bin/systemctl, /usr/bin/apt-get, /usr/bin/apt, /usr/sbin/reboot, /usr/sbin/shutdown
%sudo   ALL=(ALL:ALL) NOPASSWD: SYSADMIN
jwczjzl ALL=(ALL:ALL) ALL
XPXE_EOF
visudo -cf "${tmp}"
install -m 0440 -o root -g root "${tmp}" /etc/sudoers.d/jwczjzl
visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/jwczjzl
visudo -cf /etc/sudoers
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/sudo << 'XPXE_EOF'
/var/log/sudo.log {
    weekly
    rotate 4
    compress
    missingok
    create 640 root root
}
XPXE_EOF

modules.title: Shell 环境
modules.script:
#!/bin/bash
# x-pxe 初始化模块 shell_profile：Shell 环境
set -euo pipefail

cat > /etc/profile.d/zz-aliases.sh << 'XPXE_EOF'
unset MAILCHECK

if [ -x /usr/bin/dircolors ]; then
    test -r ~/.dircolors && eval "$(dircolors -b ~/.dircolors)" || eval "$(dircolors -b)"
    alias ls='ls --color=auto'
    alias grep='grep --color=auto'
    alias fgrep='fgrep --color=auto'
    alias egrep='egrep --color=auto'
fi
alias ll='ls -alF'
alias la='ls -A'
alias l='ls -CF'

export PATH="$PATH:/usr/local/sbin"
XPXE_EOF
chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/zz-aliases.sh
cat > /etc/profile.d/ssh-agent.sh << 'XPXE_EOF'
if [ -z "$SSH_AGENT_PID" ]; then
    eval "$(ssh-agent -s)" > /dev/null
fi
ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 2>/dev/null || true
XPXE_EOF
chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/ssh-agent.sh

#!/bin/bash

# Get load averages
LOAD1=$(awk '{print $1}' /proc/loadavg)
LOAD5=$(awk '{print $2}' /proc/loadavg)
LOAD15=$(awk '{print $3}' /proc/loadavg)
# Get free memory
MEMORY_USED=$(free -t -m | awk '/Mem/{print $3}')
MEMORY_ALL=$(free -t -m | awk '/Mem/{print $2}')
MEMORY_PERCENTAGE=$(free | awk '/Mem/{printf("%.2f%%\n", $3/$2*100)}')
# Get system uptime
UPTIME=$(awk '{print int($1)}' /proc/uptime)
UPTIME_DAYS=$((UPTIME/60/60/24))
UPTIME_HOURS=$((UPTIME/60/60%24))
UPTIME_MINS=$((UPTIME/60%60))
UPTIME_SECS=$((UPTIME%60))
# Get processes
PROCESS=$(ps -eo user=|sort|uniq -c | awk '{print $2 " " $1 }')
PROCESS_ALL=$(echo "${PROCESS}" | awk '{print $2}' | awk '{SUM += $1} END {print SUM}')
PROCESS_ROOT=$(echo "${PROCESS}" | awk '$1=="root"{print $2}')
PROCESS_USER=$(echo "${PROCESS}" | awk '$1!="root"{SUM += $2} END {print SUM+0}')
# Get processors
PROCESSOR_NAME=$(grep "model name" /proc/cpuinfo | cut -d ' ' -f3- | awk '{print $0}' | head -1)
PROCESSOR_NAME=${PROCESSOR_NAME:-$(uname -m)}
PROCESSOR_COUNT=$(grep -c '^processor' /proc/cpuinfo)
# Colors
G="\033[01;32m"
R="\033[01;31m"
D="\033[39m\033[2m"
N="\033[0m"
echo -e "${G}Login success.${N} Please execute the commands and operation data carefully."
echo -e "You are logged in to ${G}$(uname -n)${N}, Login time is $(/bin/date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S").\n"
echo -e "[System Info]\n"
echo -e "  SYSTEM    : $(head -1 /etc/os-release | awk -F'[="]+' '{print $2}')"
echo -e "  KERNEL    : $(uname -sr)"
echo -e "  UPTIME    : ${UPTIME_DAYS} days ${UPTIME_HOURS} hours ${UPTIME_MINS} minutes ${UPTIME_SECS} seconds"
echo -e "  CPU       : ${PROCESSOR_NAME} (${G}${PROCESSOR_COUNT}${N} vCPU)\n"
echo -e "  MEMORY    : ${MEMORY_USED} MB / ${MEMORY_ALL} MB (${G}${MEMORY_PERCENTAGE}${N} Used)"
echo -e "  LOAD AVG  : ${G}${LOAD1}${N} (1m), ${G}${LOAD5}${N} (5m), ${G}${LOAD15}${N} (15m)"
echo -e "  PROCESSES : ${G}${PROCESS_ROOT}${N} (root), ${G}${PROCESS_USER}${N} (user), ${G}${PROCESS_ALL}${N} (total)"
echo -e "  USERS     : ${G}$(users | wc -w)${N} users logged in"
echo -e "  BASH      : ${G}${BASH_VERSION}${N}\n"
echo -e "[Disk Usage]\n"
mapfile -t DFH < <(df -h -x zfs -x squashfs -x tmpfs -x devtmpfs -x overlay --output=target,pcent,size,used | tail -n+2)
for LINE in "${DFH[@]}"; do
    DISK_USAGE=$(echo "${LINE}" | awk '{print $2}' | sed 's/%//')
    [[ "${DISK_USAGE}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || DISK_USAGE=0
    USAGE_WIDTH=$((DISK_USAGE*60/100))
    if [ "${DISK_USAGE}" -gt 90 ]; then
        COLOR="${R}"
    else
        COLOR="${G}"
    fi
    BAR="[${COLOR}"
    for ((i=0; i<USAGE_WIDTH; i++)); do
        BAR+="="
    done
    BAR+=${D}
    for ((i=USAGE_WIDTH; i<60; i++)); do
        BAR+="="
    done
    BAR+="${N}]"
    echo "${LINE}" | awk '{ printf("Mounted: %-32s %s / %s (%s Used)\n", $1, $4, $3, $2); }' | sed -e 's/^/  /'
    echo -e "${BAR}" | sed -e 's/^/  /'
done
echo
XPXE_EOF
chmod +x /etc/update-motd.d/00-custom-header

modules.title: 内核参数
modules.script:
#!/bin/bash
# x-pxe 初始化模块 sysctl：内核参数
set -euo pipefail

cat > /etc/sysctl.d/99-fleet-netvm.conf << 'XPXE_EOF'

# ------ 转发 / IPv6 ------
# K8s 节点需要转发；纯 nginx 开着也无妨
net.ipv4.ip_forward = 1
# 确认集群无依赖 IPv6 后再禁用；若有双栈 Service 不要用这三项
net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6 = 1
net.ipv6.conf.default.disable_ipv6 = 1
net.ipv6.conf.lo.disable_ipv6 = 1

# ------ TCP ------
net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies = 1
net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse = 1
net.ipv4.tcp_fin_timeout = 30
net.ipv4.tcp_syn_retries = 5
net.ipv4.tcp_synack_retries = 5
net.ipv4.tcp_fastopen = 3
net.ipv4.tcp_slow_start_after_idle = 0

# 空闲 10 分钟后探活；配合 intvl/probes，死连接收得比 7200 快（适合 K8s/反代）
net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_time = 600
net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_intvl = 30
net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_probes = 5

# 缓冲：default 保持克制，max 允许大流量抬升（勿再把 default 调到数 MB）
net.ipv4.tcp_rmem = 4096 87380 12582912
net.ipv4.tcp_wmem = 4096 16384 12582912
net.core.rmem_default = 212992
net.core.wmem_default = 16384
net.core.rmem_max = 12582912
net.core.wmem_max = 12582912

net.ipv4.tcp_max_orphans = 262144
net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog = 32768
net.ipv4.tcp_max_tw_buckets = 1048576
net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range = 10000 65535

# 拥塞：维持发行版常见组合即可；公网入口若要试 BBR，再单独开下面两行并回归测试
# net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control = bbr
# net.core.default_qdisc = fq
# 当前建议保持（若系统已是 cubic + fq_codel，不必强改）
# net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control = cubic
# net.core.default_qdisc = fq_codel

# ------ 队列 ------
net.core.netdev_max_backlog = 32768
net.core.somaxconn = 32768

# ------ 内存 / VM（ES/Java/K8s 友好）------
vm.max_map_count = 262144
vm.dirty_background_ratio = 5
vm.dirty_ratio = 10
vm.overcommit_memory = 1
vm.swappiness = 10
vm.min_free_kbytes = 65536
vm.vfs_cache_pressure = 50

# ------ 文件监控（kubelet / 同步类）------
fs.fanotify.max_queued_events = 65536
fs.inotify.max_user_watches = 524288

# ------ 安全（与 Calico/K8s 兼容）------
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects = 0
# 严格 rp_filter=1 易在覆盖网络/不对称路径上丢包；全员用 0（或改成 2 loose）
net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.rp_filter = 0

XPXE_EOF
if ! sysctl --system; then
  echo "xpxe-warning: sysctl --system 有失败项（不中断）" >&2
fi

modules.title: 命令历史审计
modules.script:
#!/bin/bash
# x-pxe 初始化模块 history_audit：命令历史审计
set -euo pipefail

mkdir -vp '/var/log/.history'
chmod 1777 '/var/log/.history'
cat > /etc/profile.d/history-record.sh << 'XPXE_EOF'
# 审计：每次登录独立 HISTFILE；HISTSIZE/HISTFILESIZE 统一为大容量
export HISTSIZE=100000
export HISTFILESIZE=100000

LOGTIME=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H-%M-%S)
export HISTFILE="/var/log/.history/${USER}.${LOGTIME}.history"
if [ ! -f "${HISTFILE}" ]; then
  touch "${HISTFILE}"
fi
chmod 600 "${HISTFILE}"
chattr +a "${HISTFILE}" 2>/dev/null || true

HISTTIMEFORMAT="%F_%T $(whoami)#$(who -u am i 2>/dev/null| awk '{print $NF}'|sed -e 's/[()]//g'):"
export HISTTIMEFORMAT
XPXE_EOF
chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/history-record.sh

modules.title: 清理
modules.script:
#!/bin/bash
# x-pxe 初始化模块 cleanup：清理
set -euo pipefail

keep='/var/log/xpxe-firstboot.log'
find / -maxdepth 3 -name hosts.equiv -print0 2>/dev/null | xargs -0r rm -rf
find / -maxdepth 3 -name .netrc -print0 2>/dev/null | xargs -0r rm -rf
find / -maxdepth 3 -name .rhosts -print0 2>/dev/null | xargs -0r rm -rf
apt-get clean
apt-get autoclean -y
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get autoremove -y
find /var/log/apt/ -type f -delete 2>/dev/null || true
find /var/log \( -name "vmware-*.*.log" -o -name "*.log-*" -o -name "*.gz" -o -name "*log.*" \) ! -path "${keep}" 2>/dev/null | while read -r f; do rm -f "$f"; done || true
find /var/log -type f -name "*log" ! -path "${keep}" -exec truncate -s 0 {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
sync
find /tmp -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
